macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $65,000 as U.S.-Iran tensions ease
items.summary: Bitcoin reclaimed the $65,000 level after reports that U.S. and Iranian attacks had paused, lifting risk appetite across crypto and broader markets. Ethereum, XRP, and BNB also rose alongside the move.

items.title: Crypto markets rise on easing geopolitical risk; major altcoins advance
items.summary: Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, and Dogecoin climbed late Sunday as investors reacted to the pause in hostilities between the U.S. and Iran. The move was tied to improved sentiment in stock futures and a broader rebound in risk assets.

items.title: SWIFT launches blockchain-based payment system
items.summary: SWIFT announced the launch of a blockchain-based payment system, marking a significant development in financial infrastructure and cross-border payments. The announcement is being highlighted across crypto news aggregators as a major industry story.

items.title: XRP rises as SWIFT taps Ripple-linked banks for blockchain payments
items.summary: XRP gained attention after reports that SWIFT is working with Ripple-linked banks on blockchain payments. The development adds momentum to enterprise blockchain payment adoption narratives.

items.title: Hong Kong regulators force crypto platforms to drop SMS authentication
items.summary: Hong Kong’s Securities and Futures Commission reportedly directed crypto platforms to abandon SMS-based authentication, signaling tighter operational security requirements. The change is part of a wider compliance push in the region.

items.title: Trump faces renewed CLARITY Act pressure as Senate vote nears
items.summary: Crypto regulation remained in focus as the Senate moved toward a key vote on the CLARITY Act. Coverage also noted internal changes at Coinbase’s legal leadership ahead of the decision, underscoring policy uncertainty for the sector.

items.title: Bitdeer unveils $36 million Nevada factory for Bitcoin mining
items.summary: Bitdeer announced a $36 million Nevada manufacturing facility aimed at expanding Bitcoin mining infrastructure. The project is notable as mining firms continue to invest despite volatile market conditions.

items.title: WEMIX hit by $6.25 million smart contract exploit
items.summary: South Korea’s WEMIX reportedly suffered a smart contract attack that minted and transferred about $6.25 million in tokens. The team said it is tracking the funds with exchanges and security firms.

items.title: Forma Chain announces gradual shutdown and NFT migration
items.summary: Forma said it will wind down its blockchain over time, with NFTs migrating to Ethereum and users urged to withdraw assets through the Forma Bridge. The closure is one of the more notable project wind-downs in the latest crypto news cycle.

items.title: Storj Labs files Chapter 11 bankruptcy
items.summary: Storj Labs filed for Chapter 11 to restructure legacy debt while continuing operations. The move stands out as a significant project-level financial restructuring in the sector.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: OpenAI unveils ChatGPT Work for workplace automation
items.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work, an agent designed to execute tasks across different applications and files, marking a deeper push into professional AI tools. The move intensifies competition with rivals building enterprise-focused AI assistants.

items.title: Meta releases Muse Spark 1.1 to developers
items.summary: Meta opened developer access to its Muse Spark AI model and released an upgraded version, extending its strategy to commercialize AI models for external use. The rollout puts Meta in more direct competition with OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-Live voice model family
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-Live, a new family of voice models that can listen and speak simultaneously in real time. The release highlights the industry shift toward more natural, low-latency multimodal assistants.

items.title: xAI launches Grok 4.5 for coding and agentic tasks
items.summary: xAI released Grok 4.5, describing it as its most capable model yet for coding and agent-style workflows. The launch adds another major frontier model release in the fast-moving race for developer and automation use cases.

items.title: Meta plans to begin manufacturing an AI chip in September
items.summary: Reuters reports that Meta plans to start manufacturing an AI chip from September as part of a broader effort to boost its computing power. The company is also targeting a large expansion of its AI infrastructure capacity.

items.title: Micron says it will invest more than $250 billion in the U.S.
items.summary: Micron announced plans to invest more than $250 billion in the United States through 2035, citing surging AI-driven demand for memory chips. The announcement underscores how the AI boom continues to reshape semiconductor investment.

items.title: Meta plans massive new data center in Alberta
items.summary: Meta said it will build a large data center in central Alberta, its first in Canada, to support growing AI computing needs. The project reflects the industrywide scramble to secure more infrastructure for training and running large models.

items.title: New AI talent competition intensifies across major labs
items.summary: Recent reporting highlights continued movement of top researchers between Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and other labs, underscoring the escalating battle for scarce AI talent. This remains a major industry trend shaping model development and competitiveness.
